data.promptProse: Kanna Akizuki from YUZUSOFT wears a cream collared blouse, dark red midi skirt and light jacket. She pauses outside the old-fashioned snack shop with a paper bag tucked in both hands. She checks the most nostalgic candy, then offers it toward the viewer with a playful smile as the light jacket and side ponytail catch the late afternoon breeze. late afternoon street light and warm shop glow.
